item.title: Así es Elif Eralp, la abogada de origen turco y líder de La Izquierda a las puertas de la alcaldía de Berlín
item.description: Mientras el partido de derecha radical AfD continúa con su ascenso en las urnas alemanas , una abogada de origen turco y 45 años se ha convertido este domingo en la elección de los berlineses en los comicios a la alcaldía de la capital. Se trata de Elif Eralp , líder del partido La Izquierda (Die Linke), que ha ganado con un 25% de los votos. El partido de izquierda radical (25%) se ha impuesto en las elecciones a la CDU (20%) y está en condiciones de arrebatarle la alcaldía, mientras que AfD también ha avanzado con fuerza y se ha situado en torno al 15%. Eralp, de 45 años, no ocultó su… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: UK to introduce special rape and serious sexual offence courts, amid low prosecution rate
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced dedicated courts for sexual offence cases. These new courts aim to expedite convictions and reduce case backlogs significantly. Specialized training will be provided to court personnel for handling sensitive cases. Victims will receive a dedicated point of contact throughout the legal process. This initiative supports the government's commitment to reducing violence against women. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: ¿Cómo interpretar que Merz se niegue a renunciar tras derrota de CDU en las elecciones regionales?
item.description: El Gobierno de Alemania y las distintas fuerzas políticas analizan los resultados de las elecciones regionales celebradas el 20 de septiembre: las del Parlamento de Berlín y las del estado federado de Mecklemburgo-Pomerania Occidental. Ambas votaciones aumentan la presión sobre el futuro político del canciller alemán, Friedrich Merz, y muestran que no todo está perdido para la izquierda en el país. Para analizar el tema, conversamos con Ralf Leiteritz, politólogo de la Universidad de Potsdam (Alemania), en El Invitado del Día de France 24. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Agente del ICE hiere de bala a un hombre migrante en Austin, Texas
item.description: Tras una breve persecución, un agente del Servicio de Inmigración y Control de Aduanas (ICE) disparó e hirió a un hombre en el norte de Austin, la capital de Texas. La víctima, un adulto, fue trasladada a un hospital tras recibir un disparo en el torso y posteriormente a un centro de detención. Desde el regreso del presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, a la Casa Blanca, se han contabilizado al menos 17 conductores baleados durante operativos del ICE, seis de los cuales murieron, según The Washington Post. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Informe desde Berlín: Merz descarta renunciar tras derrota electoral de la CDU
item.description: Desde la sede de la Unión Demócrata Cristiana (CDU), el canciller alemán, Friedrich Merz, aseguró que no renunciará a su cargo tras la derrota de su partido en las elecciones para la alcaldía de Berlín, en las que resultó vencedor el partido de izquierda, y después de que la AfD consolidara su ascenso electoral en Mecklemburgo-Pomerania Occidental. Merz afirmó que el resultado "responde a su persona" y que se trata de cambios más profundos que exige el país. Informe de nuestra corresponsal, Valentina Godoy. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: France and Canada deepen economic and defense ties
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney have announced plans to deepen economic ties between their countries following a meeting at the weekend. Macron welcomed Carney in Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, a French territory off the coast of Canada’s Newfoundland. The two leaders discussed opportunities to share infrastructure in the space and defence sectors, as Canada’s trade relationship with the US deteriorates and Europe looks to diversify its energy supplies. item.description: On the eve of this week’s summit between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, Americans feel better about China, according to a poll released on Monday. They see Beijing as less of a threat, are less supportive of Taiwan and are more likely to favour engagement over containment than last year or in 2024, when views hit an all-time low. item.title: Putin consolidates grip on Russia as 49 Ukraine war veterans elected to parliament
item.description: United Russia party’s record victory in tightly controlled vote likely to be used as evidence of support for war against Ukraine Russia’s new parliament will include 49 deputies who have taken part in the war against Ukraine, officials have said after a landslide victory by the ruling United Russia party in widely criticised elections. The pro-Kremlin party won a record 355 seats in the country’s 450-seat Duma lower house of parliament, according to preliminary figures. The result further consolidates Vladimir Putin’s grip on power and gives United Russia a super-majority bigger than its… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: REPLAY: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz in post-vote comments
item.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and CDU representatives held a press conference on Monday, September 21, after the party suffered its worst regional election defeat in postwar Germany. Merz called the result in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania a “disaster”, as the CDU fell below the 5% threshold for entering the state parliament. According to FRANCE 24 Europe editor Armen Georgian, Merz and his party’s Berlin candidate, Stefan Evers, offered no concrete solutions to address the historic defeat, despite pledging to keep the coalition together in the name of a “democratic future.” Fuente: France 24 - English.

Trump has ramped up campaigning, including spending heavily on advertising and proposing $5,000 payments to voters who support Republicans. item.title: Sorbonne Professor Hans Stark: 'Merz is in a very, very fragile situation'
item.description: The far right AfD claims it has become Germany’s new “people’s party”. The statement comes after AfD claimed its second regional election win in as many weeks, ramping up pressure on the poorly performing CDU and Chancellor Friedrich Merz. The far-left party also advanced, winning its third regional election thanks to its latest victory in Berlin. Perspective spoke to Hans Stark, professor in contemporary German civilization at Sorbonne University, who said that Merz is now in a very fragile situation, but that there is no obvious candidate to take over from him. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Moscow: Ukraine launches huge drone attack as election wraps up
item.description: Ukraine launched more than 1,000 drones at Russia, including hundreds at the capital Moscow, in its largest attack of the war so far, officials said Sunday. The attack came as Russia wrapped up the final day of voting in tightly controlled parliamentary elections that President Vladimir Putin has cast as a test of support for the war in Ukraine. item.title: Regional losses for Germany's ruling CDU
item.description: Another electoral setback for German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, as his centre-right CDU performed poorly in two state elections on Sunday. Projections showed the party failing to enter the state parliament in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, where the far-right AfD came out on top, while the far-left Die Linke led the vote in Berlin. The AfD also made significant gains in both states, building on its recent victory in Saxony-Anhalt. France 24 Europe editor Armen Georgian shares further insights. Fuente: France 24 - English.

Tras el otro revés sufrido por la aplastante victoria de la ultraderecha en Sajonia-Anhalt, ya descrita como un fracaso de las políticas del canciller, ¿podrá Friedrich Merz sobrevivir a estos dos nuevos reveses? Esto dicen los analistas. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: France 24

item.title: Former WTO head Pascal Lamy on the EU’s China choice: get a rebalance, or go protectionist
item.description: Pascal Lamy served two consecutive terms as director general of the World Trade Organization from 2005 to 2013. Before that, he spent decades in various French government roles, contributing to the building of the European Union. He was chief of staff to European Commission president Jacques Delors from 1985 to 1994, and European trade commissioner from 1999 to 2004. Here, he discusses Europe’s trade tensions with China, the continent’s growth potential problem and the WTO’s need for stronger... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: 2637 reproducciones · 55 reacciones | Colunas de fumaça subiram acima de uma refinaria de petróleo em Moscou neste domingo (20), após um ataque de drones atingir a capital russa, conforme mostram vídeos publicados nas redes sociais. O ataque, considerado o maior já registrado com drones ucranianos na região de Moscou, matou três pessoas e danificou parte da refinaria, segundo autoridades russas. O episódio ocorreu no último dia das eleições parlamentares no país. Rússia e Ucrânia continuaram atacando a infraestrutura energética uma da outra, apesar do anúncio feito na segunda-feira (14) pelo presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, de que os dois países haviam concordado com um cessar-fogo. 📲 #RecordNews #Notícias 🎥 Reprodução: Reuters | Record News
